answer: Each agent in an oasis garden owns one marble-lined cistern, locked with a 70-credit bond and a key-bound serial. Each epoch the owner files its level; the auditor recomputes it from the public drawdown table within 3%, and a reading beyond 3% or a reused serial burns the bond. First filing costs 40, the k-th 40+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,537,500 plus 70,000 locked; a rented cistern fails, one serial per key. An honest gardener pays 40 once.
